services.title: Aluminium Photo Prints Dubai | HD Metal Prints on ChromaLuxe
services.h1: Aluminium photo prints, made in Dubai
services.lede: Your photography, dye-infused into ChromaLuxe metal panels — depth, luminosity and permanence that photographic paper cannot reach.
services.metaDescription: HD aluminium photo prints in Dubai on ChromaLuxe panels. Museum-grade metal prints from 15×15 cm to 120×240 cm, 65-year archival rating, 48-hour express, UAE-wide delivery.
services.schemaDescription: Museum-grade HD photo prints dye-infused into ChromaLuxe aluminium panels, from 15×15 cm to 120×240 cm, produced in Al Quoz, Dubai.
services.imgAlt: Landscape photograph printed on a glossy aluminium metal panel

paras: A metal photo print is not paper behind glass — it is the image itself, fused inside the coating of a rigid aluminium panel. Blacks read deeper, highlights carry a subtle metallic luminosity, and the surface needs no glazing, so there is nothing between the viewer and the photograph. For portrait, landscape, architectural and fine-art photographers across Dubai and the UAE, it has become the default for exhibition and client work.

We print exclusively on ChromaLuxe panels — the industry's reference substrate, with an independently tested display permanence of more than 65 years. Every file is colour-managed against a calibrated ICC profile for metal and soft-proofed before it touches the press.

list: Sizes: from 15×15 cm desk pieces to 120×240 cm single panels; larger works are produced as multi-panel installations with precision-matched seams.
Finishes: gloss white for maximum vibrancy, matte white for glare-free gallery light, and brushed silver — where highlights reveal the raw metal grain.
Mounting: hidden float mounts as standard, so the panel appears to hover 15 mm off the wall; standoffs and flush mounts on request.

paras: Email or WhatsApp your file with the size and finish you have in mind. We check resolution, send a colour-managed proof and a firm quote within one working day, then produce in 2–4 working days — or 48 hours on express. Delivery covers all seven Emirates, with white-glove installation available for large works.
Trade pricing is available for photographers, galleries and interior designers with repeat volume.

services.metaDescription: Corporate metal signage in Dubai: reception logos, wayfinding and branded aluminium panels for offices, hotels and retail. Colour-managed to brand guidelines, installed across the UAE.
services.schemaDescription: Reception logos, wayfinding and branded aluminium panels for offices, hotels and retail — dye-sublimated, colour-managed and installed across the UAE.
services.imgAlt: Modern Dubai office towers where branded metal signage is installed

sections.h2: Signage printed into the metal, not onto it
paras: Most interior signage is vinyl or laminate on a substrate — layers that peel, scratch and dull under cleaning. Sublimated metal signage is different: your logo and brand colours are dye-infused into the coating of an aluminium panel at 199°C. There is nothing on the surface to damage, so reception logos and wayfinding stay sharp through years of daily contact.

Colour accuracy is the discipline here. We work from your vector artwork and Pantone or brand-guideline references, hold a measured tolerance of ΔE < 2, and keep the profile on file so a panel ordered next year matches the one on your wall today.

list: Reception and lobby logos — float-mounted or standoff-fixed, gloss, matte or brushed silver.
Wayfinding and door signage — full suites with consistent colour and typography across every panel.
Branded interior panels — feature walls, values walls and campaign graphics for offices, hotels, clinics and retail.
Menu boards and retail displays — wipe-clean surfaces that stay presentable in F&B environments.

paras: For fit-out contractors, interior designers and facilities teams across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the wider UAE, we handle measurement, production and white-glove installation as one scope. Standard production is 2–4 working days from approved artwork; phased delivery is available for multi-floor projects.

services.title: Metal Awards & Plaques Dubai | Custom Recognition on Aluminium
services.lede: Full-colour artwork, engrave-sharp typography and the weight of real metal — recognition pieces dye-infused into aluminium, produced in Dubai on event timelines.
services.metaDescription: Custom metal awards and recognition plaques in Dubai. Dye-infused aluminium trophies with full-colour artwork, engrave-sharp type and weighted bases. Express production, UAE-wide delivery.
services.schemaDescription: Custom dye-sublimated aluminium awards, trophies and recognition plaques with full-colour artwork, produced in Al Quoz, Dubai with express options for corporate events.
services.imgAlt: Polished metal surface catching light, like a custom aluminium award

paras: Most corporate awards are engraved acrylic or laser-etched steel — one colour, one texture, forgettable by the following quarter. Sublimated metal awards carry full-colour artwork inside the panel itself: brand gradients, photography, portraits of the recipient's work — anything you can design, rendered with the depth and permanence of dye fused into aluminium.
Type stays engrave-sharp because it is printed at high resolution and infused, not cut. Names, dates and citations remain crisp at small sizes, and the surface never chips or fades.

list: Desk awards — panels on weighted metal or timber bases, from 15×15 cm.
Wall plaques — float-mounted recognition walls, employee-of-the-quarter series, donor walls.
Milestone pieces — retirements, closings, launches; single pieces receive the same colour management as production runs.
Series & programmes — repeat quarterly or annual awards, with your template kept on file for exact consistency.

paras: Award ceremonies do not move, so we plan backwards from your event date. Standard production is 2–4 working days from approved artwork; 48-hour express covers late confirmations, and delivery reaches venues across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and all Emirates. For runs above fifty pieces we produce a physical pre-production sample for sign-off.

faqs.a: A metal poster is an image dye-infused into the coating of an aluminium panel using heat and pressure (sublimation), not printed on paper. The colour becomes part of the metal, so it never peels, cracks or fades, and the surface is waterproof and scratch-resistant.

faqs.q: How much do metal posters cost in the UAE?
faqs.a: Prices start at AED 120 for a Small (30×40 cm) poster and go up to AED 650 for XL (100×150 cm). Any design is available in any size, and custom sizes are quoted on request over WhatsApp.
We print in Dubai and deliver across all seven emirates in 2–3 days. Next-day express is available within Dubai, and delivery is free on orders over AED 300.

faqs.q: Can I print my own photo or design on metal?
faqs.a: Yes. Send us your file over WhatsApp or email — we check the resolution, colour-manage it for metal, send a proof, and print it in the size and finish you choose. This is our metal photo print service.

faqs.q: How do I hang a metal poster?
faqs.a: Every poster is lightweight and ships with a simple mount included, so it goes up in a couple of minutes with no drilling drama. Float mounts and standoffs are available for larger pieces.

faqs.q: Are metal prints suitable for kitchens and bathrooms?
faqs.a: Yes — the print is waterproof and humidity-resistant, so kitchens, bathrooms and even shaded balconies are all fine. There is no glass to fog and nothing on the surface to lift in damp air.

faqs.q: Do you offer corporate signage and awards?
faqs.a: Yes. Alongside posters we produce corporate metal signage, branded interior panels and custom metal awards and plaques, all colour-managed and produced in our Dubai studio with express options for event deadlines.

faqs.q: How do I place an order?
faqs.a: Pick a design and size, then tap Order on WhatsApp — the message is pre-filled for you. Tell us the size and we confirm the price and delivery in a few minutes.
